adjudications.name: Light My Cells 2: Transmitted Light to Fluorescence Challenge
adjudications.event: France-BioImaging; submitted to ISBI 2027, acceptance not established
adjudications.rationale: A distinct second edition, with validation available before the cutoff; two fluorescence-prediction tasks are one annual unit. Image-to-image synthesis does not meet the text-conditioned generation definition.
adjudications.evidence: Organizer announcement dated 24 September 2026 states validation began on 21 September and registration/data access were open. Final evaluation and results were scheduled for December. The platform says submitted to ISBI 2027, which is not evidence of accepted conference affiliation.
adjudications.limitation: The rules retain a legacy 2024 publication date and inconsistent external-data clauses. Those clauses are not used to infer current post-challenge access or resource policy. The multi-site acquisition statement supports centers, not acquisition-country counts.
adjudications.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review

adjudications.name: LUNOVO26: Lung Nodule Volumetry Challenge
adjudications.event: LUNOVO26; EIBALL/QMIC and Radboudumc project-led evaluation
adjudications.opening_precision: on or before; debug data and submission phase
adjudications.rationale: Dated 2026 algorithm-evaluation round with phased submissions; vendor eligibility does not exclude an otherwise eligible imaging evaluation event under the revised scope.
adjudications.evidence: Timeline confirms debug data and phase on 7 April, Phase 1 on 10 July and Phase 3 on 28 October 2026. Participation requires a CE-certified volumetry product and a research agreement. Containers estimate lung-nodule volumes from CT with supplied nodule locations.
adjudications.limitation: Public download refers only to the debug/development dataset. Test access and participation remain restricted. March 31 launch/news and April 7 debug timeline are preserved as distinct milestones; no exact registration date or final execution is inferred.
adjudications.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review

adjudications.name: COBRA 2026: Cone-Beam CT Reconstruction for Radiation Therapy
adjudications.rationale: Previously retained but excluded for a 2027 final event. Reincluded because registration/training opened in July 2026. One cross-year competition, not a separate 2027 analytical unit.
adjudications.evidence: Official timetable specifies registration/training release on 13 July 2026, validation in December and final test/results in 2027. Clinical projections from six centers are combined with synthetic data. Final test uses organizer/platform execution; validation prediction files are retained as a separate scoring artifact.
adjudications.limitation: Dataset quantity and acquisition countries were not established from reviewed sources. General discussion of thorax/pelvis artifacts does not identify the actual cohort anatomy. Existing registration-and-approval access coding is retained. Continued evaluation is a specified future phase, not an observed operational service.
adjudications.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review

adjudications.name: OWL: Observing What Models Learn
adjudications.event: CVPath workshop at WACV 2027; participation opened in 2026
adjudications.rationale: Algorithm outputs include per-case explanations in addition to recurrence predictions. This meets explicit reasoning as operationally defined here; an optional text form does not independently establish a vision-language or report-generation objective. Permitted foundation encoders do not establish a foundation-model benchmark objective.
adjudications.evidence: Workshop page documents registration/starter-kit opening on 22 August 2026. Predictions include recurrence time, a derived risk category, attribution map and per-case interpretability report. Evaluation specifies perturbation faithfulness, AI and pathology panels, and external validation. Expert/output results were not established by the cutoff.
adjudications.limitation: Workshop and platform timelines differ on the October testing milestones; the platform separately schedules external validation for February 2027 and contains a workshop-year typo. No scheduled phase is coded as executed. A method manuscript is distinct from the algorithm-produced per-case interpretation. WACV 2027 affiliation is retained separately from the analytical year.
adjudications.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review

adjudications.name: PRISM-AI Challenge: Mammography-based Breast Cancer Risk Prediction
adjudications.rationale: A bounded organized evaluation with registration closure, algorithm-submission deadline and common analysis plan qualifies even without a model-development phase. No official annual edition is specified; 2025 registration opening determines the analytical year, separately from 2026 assessment.
adjudications.evidence: Registration opened in December 2025 and closed in June 2026; debugging submissions opened on 4 August. The final test was postponed to 2 November, after the cutoff, so final execution and results are not counted. Existing algorithms predict five-year risk from mammograms, with discrimination, calibration and clinical-utility assessments.
adjudications.limitation: No prescribed training dataset. Example inputs are for format checking, not a supplied training cohort. The hidden evaluation cohort covers twenty Dutch screening units; source-cohort and primary-analysis quantities retain separate scopes. Participation rules alone do not establish a data-use licence.
adjudications.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review

statistics.extraction_status_note: Prior 337-edition coding retained; five source-linked additions/reinclusions reviewed 2026-11-03 against participation-open cutoff 2026-11-01. Audit dates are not backdated. No scheduled assessment is counted as executed.

qualifications: Scope-expanded measures are not interchangeable with the former narrow definitions.
Geography can describe a source subset or a specified acquisition plan; it is not a complete population map.
Post-challenge resource information includes policies/plans, observed resources and restrictions; it is not a count of unrestricted open datasets.
Participation preserves teams, finalists and individuals separately; registrations and submission attempts do not enter this coverage measure.
resource_information_followup.scope: Prior resource-information round; current totals are in documentation and record_field_reconciliation_summary.

paper_followup_summary.scope: Targeted organizer-paper follow-up; not an exhaustive literature search for all remaining fields

cutoff_update.opening_rule: Formal registration, challenge-data access, or a submission/evaluation phase open on or before 2026-11-01; a planning announcement alone is insufficient.
cutoff_update.year_rule: Organizer-designated competition year retained when available; otherwise participation opening year. Conference/presentation year is recorded separately. PRISM-AI is 2025, OWL and Light My Cells 2 are 2026.
